selection.ownership: Bookingmood, Keizersgracht 520h, Amsterdam, North Holland 1017 EK, Netherlands. Co-founders Adriaan de Jager, Lennart Visscher, Wouter Raateland. International vacation-rental booking API at api.bookingmood.com, used in 50+ countries.

research.searchCoverage: Official Bookingmood API v1 (PostgREST, Bearer API keys from organization settings, GET /products, GET /bookings, GET /availability), Amsterdam Netherlands operator, and dated incident search (Bookingmood + security breach/incident) reviewed on 2026-09-13. Booking.com / Booking Holdings incidents are a distinct company and were excluded from this provider's qualifying coverage.

Official Bookingmood API v1 at https://api.bookingmood.com/v1 uses Bearer API keys. Dated 2026-09-13 incident search found no qualifying Bookingmood compromise after excluding Booking.com / Booking Holdings hits. Not a breach-free claim.
